description_en: Queries the permission information about a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 查询指定智能接入网关实例的授权信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-grant-sag-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-hdg0000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGrantSagRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the returned page.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的页码。

默认值是1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页展示的授权条目数。

默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

GrantRule.description_en: The information about the permissions that the SAG instance grants to the CCN instance of another Alibaba Cloud account

CcnInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the CCN instance

CcnUid.description_en: The user ID (UID) of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CCN instance belongs
CcnUid.description_zh: 云连接网实例所属的账号ID

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the permissions were granted

GrantTrafficService.description_en:
Indicates whether the CCN instance is granted permissions to manage network traffic from the SAG instance.

true: granted.
false: not granted
GrantTrafficService.description_zh:
是否给跨账号的云连接网实例授权了智能接入网关实例的流量服务能力。

true：已授权。
false：未授权

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the SAG instance belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的账号ID

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页展示的授权条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
